HBC: Initialism of health and beauty care.
HBCU: Initialism of historically black college or university.
HBD: Having two of the same allele at a locus, or base at an SNP, where both copies are from a single ancestor strand.
HBO: Initialism of Home Box Office, a premium movie and entertainment channel.
HBOS: HBOS, a former British bank and insurance company.
